title: MSP Recovery, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: MSP Recovery, Inc. (OTC: MSPR), a micro-cap healthcare recovery company, filed an 8-K disclosing two one-time advances totaling $0.2 million: $0.1 million from Hazel Partners Holdings LLC under its discretionary working capital credit facility, and $0.1 million from VRM MSP Recovery Partners, LLC from recovery proceeds. Both advances are explicitly non-recurring and the company states no additional funding is available under either facility.
key_points: Company received $0.1 million advance from Hazel Partners Holdings LLC on April 16, 2026, under a discretionary Operational Collection Floor mechanism
As of Q3-2025, aggregate advances under the Operational Collection Floor had reached approximately $6.0 million with no remaining capacity
Hazel letter explicitly states the advance does not reinstate, replenish, or reopen availability under the facility
Company received separate $0.1 million advance from VRM MSP Recovery Partners, LLC from recovery proceeds
VRM advance must be reimbursed upon closing of any loan or financing transaction, including potential Chapter 11 DIP financing
Both agreements are characterized as one-time accommodations with no commitment to future funding

(OTC: MSPR), a micro-cap company, has exhausted its primary working capital facility and is dependent on ad hoc, non-committed advances to meet operating expenses. The explicit language cautioning that the advances should not be viewed as indicative of future funding willingness suggests heightened liquidity risk.
